::: {#def-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error

The **prediction error** of a prediction $\fitted$
of an observed outcome $y$
is the prediction minus the observed outcome:

$$\prederr \eqdef \fitted - y$$

The prediction can be a [fitted value](#def-fitted-value)
or a prediction for an observation that was not used to fit the model.
Prediction error is oriented the same way as
[estimation error](#def-estimation-error):
estimate minus true value.
For an observation that was used to fit the model,
$\prederr_i = \fitted_i - y_i = -\resid_i$,
the negative of its [residual](#def-residual).
:::
